name: @budaknyenyel/i18n-mcp
description: MCP server for the Indonesian-English localization linter

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); for(const f of ['dist/bin.js','dist/index.js','dist/i18n.v1.json','dist/i18n-lint.jar','README.md','LICENSE','CHANGELOG.md']) if(!fs.existsSync(f)) throw new Error('Missing publish artifact: '+f); for(const spec of Object.values(require('./package.json').dependencies)) if(spec.startsWith('file:')) throw new Error('Local dependency in publish package');"
